sentences.text: 1. By means of the present petition, the petitioners herein seek a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to decide their representation seeking for compensation for a portion of land, the survey number of which has not been given in the Writ Petition.

The tabular chart as Annexure-A has been appended with the Writ Petition to assert that the survey numbers and the area mentioned Patel Shankarbhai Joitabhai vs State Of Gujarat on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76404326/
1 therein had been owned by the petitioners.

sentences.text: It is then stated that for construction of National Highway (National Highway No.8), a four lane highway, for 388.400 KM to 495.000 KM (Ratanpur to Chiloda), the proposal was sent by the National Highway Authority for acquisition.
Survey was done, map was prepared and acquisition process was undertaken in accordance with the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.

It is further contended that during the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/2558/2024 ORDER DATED: 16/02/2024 undefined acquisition process, a decision was taken by the National Highway Authority to construct six lane highway and therefore, it was decided to acquire the additional land for construction of six lane highway.
Thereafter, the award dated 30.09.2004 came to be passed by the competent authority.

2. From the above noted averments in paragraph 3.4 of the Writ Petition, there is no clarity as to why the petitioners had not raised any dispute at the time of making of the award dated 30.09.2004,
which was confined to the acquisition for construction of four lane highway, as asserted by the learned counsel for the petitioners.
The acquisition notifications are not on record.

The assertion in the Writ Petition that while constructing six lane highway, additional land belonging to the petitioners had been utilized without adopting due process of law, cannot be substantiated by any material on record.

On a query made by this Court as to how the petitioners could explain the latches of 20 years on their part, the contention is that the construction of national highway only commenced in the year 2016 , which is also without any basis.
3. For the aforesaid, no merit is found in the Writ Petition.
No direction, as such, can be given to decide the representation moved by the petitioners.
Moreover, the National Highway Authority has not been impleaded in the Writ Petition.
The Writ Petition is accordingly dismissed.

Sd/-
